_note: Urban and international product-demand trends, driving the motif-mockup nudge (Features.docx: 'Analyzes trending urban and international product demands (e.g., minimalist decor, lifestyle accessories) and generates realistic visual mockups... increase their product value from Rs 250 to Rs 1,200+').
_honesty: These are EDITORIAL trends, hand-written from what sells in urban Indian and export handicraft channels. They are NOT computed from live search or marketplace data -- no such feed is wired up, and pretending otherwise in a demo would be a lie the judges could ask about. Refreshing this file is a manual, quarterly job. If a real trends API is added later, keep this file as the offline fallback.

_fields.base_price: Typical urban retail price of the finished modern product, in rupees. Used for the value story; sourced from listed prices on Indian D2C sites, not from our own sales.
_fields.template: Must match a template name in assets/mockup_templates/corners.json.

trends.label: Minimalist home decor
trends.demand_note: Urban buyers want plain, neutral rooms with one handmade accent piece.

trends.label: Everyday carry & lifestyle accessories
trends.demand_note: Canvas totes and sleeves with a real handmade print sell year-round, not just at festivals.
trends.audience: Students and office buyers in metros

trends.label: Corporate gifting & desk objects
trends.demand_note: Companies buy handmade in bulk for Diwali and onboarding kits -- the highest per-order value an artisan can reach.

trends.label: Folk art for export
trends.demand_note: European and US buyers pay a premium for documented folk art with a GI tag and an artist story.
